name: Operation and Maintenance lab
description:
Aircraft system and instrument lab is equipped with a facility of PZL Rzeszów SO-3. PZL Rzeszów SO-3 is Polish turbojet engines designed by the Instytut Lotnictwa (Institute of Aeronautics ) and manufactured by WSK PZL Rzeszów, to power the PZL TS-11 Iskra jet trainer. The engine has a seven-stage compressor, annular combustion chambers, and a single-stage turbine. Overhaul life 400 hours. From PZL Rzeszów SO-3 Jet engine students can understand function of jet engine like fuel system, lubrication system, hydraulic system, engine starter, etc.
In this lab, some sophisticated equipments are there. We have SO3 Turbojet Engine acquired from Indian Air force. Some detailed charts and diagrams of different systems of SO3 Turbojet Engine are also available. We have some miscellaneous system components of Boeing 737 Aircraft like stabilator trim screw, valves, oil and fuel pumps, safety equipments etc. In this lab some helicopter equipments are also available for study purpose. Students get practical exposure on real Aircraft components. We have some parts of gliders which was built by Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd. We have some Engine instruments, pressure instruments and avionics equipment in this lab as well.

name: Environmental  Lab
description: The EnvironmentalEngineering laboratory practical provides good insight into different experimental methods relevant to water, wastewater and Air Pollution monitoring.In this lab we performs various test on water and wastewater samples to check pH value, total dissolved solids, BOD and COD, Total suspended particles etc. The Laboratory also provides sophisticated Equipments for good testing, teaching and research facilities.

name: Engineering Mechanics Lab
description: Basic understanding of different aspect of this subject is covered in this lab. The lab consist of universal force table , simply supported & overhanging beam apparatus , simple roof truss model , wheel & differential axle apparatus , single purchase crab etc. The student can compare their result experimentally & analytically using above experimental set up.

name: Geotechnical Engineering Lab
description: Geotechnical Engineering is concerned with the engineering behavior of earth materials. The Geotechnical Engineering laboratory has standard soil testing equipment including soil classification, compaction, consolidation, direct shear, permeability, unconfined compression and stress and strain controlled monotonic triaxial devices.

name: Aerodynamics lab
description: In aerodynamics lab we have low speed subsonic wind tunnel. Wind tunnel is an equipment to measure an air property over the any solid object like Different types of Airfoil, Cylinder, Flatplate. Wind tunnels are large tubes with air blowing through them. The tunnels are used to replicate the actions of an object flying through the air or moving along the ground. Researchers use wind tunnels to learn more about how an aircraft will fly. The wind tunnel moves air around an object, making it seem as if the object is really flying.

name: Avionics Lab
description: Avionics means Aviation Electronics, a system used for Aircrafts controls and navigation. In this lab announciator panel, GPS module and many more equipments are available for students. We are developing cockpit shell for flight simulator. So that students can get virtual experience of operations of aircraft controls and instrumentation. They will be able to learn IFR and VFR flying also. That will help them to clear their Fundamentals of Avionics and instruments.

name: Aircraft Design lab
description: The aircraft design process entails the estimation of weights, performance, structural loads, aerodynamics, controls, and propulsion. The lab is equipped with models to understand the various concepts related to design. The 1/5 scale model of LCA Tejas is a beautiful feather of our department. It is widely used to discuss and understand various aspects of the design process such as Double Delta wing, supersonic Aerodynamics, Jet Engine Integration, Weapon Systems and Control Surfaces. The lab gives students to explore the ideas of different configurations of the aircraft for various applications.

name: Networking Lab
description:
No. of Computers: 17

Configuration: INTEL CORE I-5, 4 GB RAM, 500 GB HDD 

The intention of Network Laboratory is to learn fundamental concepts related to networking. The lab resources, apart from computer systems, are various networking components. This lab is to provide an exposure to the students with hands on experience on various simulator tools. This lab is used to carry out practical of the subjects like Computer Network, Advanced Computer Network, Advance wireless mobile Network, etc.

name: Design Engineering lab
description:
Airframe of unmanned agriculture aircraft was built by students of Aeronautical Engineering of SVIT as an academic project of Design Engineering. This aircraft has been designed to spray 32 litres of pesticides to be spread in farms. Airframe is having 20 feet length and 30 feet wing span. Designed maximum take off weight will be around 230 kg. It can be equipped with 60 HP piston prop engine. It has been designed to be flown by 5 channel radio control system. This model is also useful to understand monocoque and semi monocoque construction of airframe. 
In this lab students gets hands on practices on sheet metal work like cutting, beading, drilling trimming, fitting , riveting etc. They learn overall sheet metal manufacturing processes for Aircrafts. They get knowledge about semi monocoque fuselage construction, sheet metal wing construction, horizontal stabilizer and vertical fin construction. Fix landing gear construction etc.

name: CFD and Modeling Lab
description:
A well-equipped computer lab with advanced computing facilities is established for the benefit of the Aeronautical engineering students. High end terminals supported by latest hardware and softwares.
At Geometric Modeling Lab students get professional training on 2D & 3D drafting of Aeronautical Engineering drawings using the latest version of CATIA V5-6R 2018 License software. To carryout various CFD & FEA analysis lab is equipped with 25 computers with latest configurations and ANASYS student version software installed in them.

name: AUTOMOBILE ENGINEERING LAB
description: This lab is use for Mechanical engineering students with facilities for the group of 30 students to carry out experiments. The lab is well-equipped and enables students to understand the fundamentals of Automotive Engineering which includes basic structure, body style, and wheel & tyre assembly. Major Equipment in Automobile Engineering Lab are: - Cut sectional chassis of Ambassador car, cut section four stroke four-cylinder petrol engine, fuel injection system, steering gear unit, Chassis of an automobile, synchromesh gear box, Hydraulic and Mechanical brake.

name: BME Lab
description: Basic Mechanical Engineering Laboratory has various Boiler Models like Cocharan Boiler, Babcock Wilcox Boiler and Lancashire Boiler and Various models of Accessories for understanding working principle of Steam Boiler. We have a model of Refrigerator to understand the VCRS cycle and various components of VCRS system. We have also a model of different couplings and gears to understand the function and application of each. In our Laboratory we have a models of a 2- stroke and 4-stroke petrol and diesel Engine to understand the various components of IC Engine and working of IC Engine.

name: Computer Aided Manufacturing lab
description: The laboratory was established by a Mechanical Engineering Department to provide our students with knowledge and hands-on experience in the area of Computer Aided Manufacturing and considering the emerging research and development in the area of manufacturing segment in the industrial fraternity. The objective of the CAM laboratory is to prepare the students industry ready and to acquire employability skills with the know of how the CNC programming and cutting tool path generation through CNC simulation software by using G-Codes and M-codes. In addition, it is aimed at to demonstrate and understand the importance of automation and its predominant role in the assembly line of shop floor, so that to satisfy the need of agil e manufacturing to meet the urging need of global competitiveness of upcoming industries. On completion of this simulation through CNC software, students will have the knowledge of key manufacturing technologies and their underlying principles applied in current manufacturing industry and will be comfortable with using commercial CAM systems to solve real world problems. Also, students are expected to develop the ability to work in industrial environment to design programs for various models and various (multi-axis) CNC machine tools. Our laboratory functioning with the following equipments. CAM laboratory comprise of following computer tools, machines, and setups: 1. CNC Milling Machine and 2. A set of Four axis Dobot Magician Robot 3. Dell makes Computers (13 nos.) 4. A Compressor 1.CNC Machining Center This CNC Milling machine with an optional 6 station Automatic Tool Changer and this machine can be compatible with Fanuc control system., Model: MTAB XLMILL, Features: PC-based 3 axis continuous path control system, 6 station programmable ATC, Programmable Spindle, Fully enclosed working area, Hydro-pneumatic vice, FMS / CIM Compatible, 2. A set of 4 - Axis Dobot Magician Robotic Arm This is a modular 4 axis articulated robot, which consists of medium duty stepper motors for all joint actuation. The controller consists of easy plug and play type cable for swift interfacing and online programming through dedicated software for various applications. Programming and control of the articulated robot for various applications both through manual as well as auto mode for repetitive tasks. The robotic arm can also be operated by Bluetooth module, WIFI module and Joystick control kit. The Dobot Magician Robot is also equipped with the Belt Conveyor, Linear Rail system, and the Vision System. The students can also learn the graphical programming (Blockly- developed by a Google) and perform the various tasks. Dobot Magician Features: Number of axis: 4, Payload: 500g, Maximum Reach: 320 mm, Position Repeatability: 0.2 mm, Controller: Dobot Integrated Controller, Path type: Point to point, linear and circular interpolation path, End effectors: 3-D Printer Kit, Laser Engraving, Pen Holder for drawing and Writing, Vacuum Suction cup, and Mechanical Gripper.

name: Control Engineering Lab
description:
The feedback automatic control systems are an essential feature of numerous industrial processes, scientific instruments and even commercial, social and management situations. A thorough understanding of the elementary principles of this all embracing technology is of great relevance for all engineers and scientists. Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems are often integrated with control system. This lab gives hands on experience of various hydraulic and pneumatic circuits.
Facility:
Hardware
Hydraulic Trainer with different types of DCVs, Solenoid Valve, Flow Control Valves.
Pneumatic Trainer with compressor, Flow Control Valve, Shuttle Valve, different DCVs.
Software
Hydraulic Simulation Software by Festo Controls Pvt. Ltd. (15 Licenses)

Subjects:
Control Engineering
and Oil Hydraulics and Pneumatics

name: Dynamics of Machines Lab
description:
Dynamics of Machines laboratory, also known as DOM lab is associated with UG subjects such as Theory of Machines, Dynamics of Machinery and Theory of Vibration (Aeronautical Engg.).
All equipment here are in running conditions and all the practical of the syllabus and beyond syllabus are performed.
The laboratory has display models, apparatus, instruments and equipment. Major of them are Gyroscope, Universal Governor setup, Whirling of shafts setup, Cam analysis setup, Vib-lab frames, stroboscope and vibrometer.
Our department has received a grant of Rs. 15 Lacs from AICTE for Dynamic Balancing Machine. The Machine will be installed and commissioned soon.

name: Fluid Power Engineering Lab
description: Fluid Power Engineering Laboratory is equipped with Pelton Turbine, Francis Turbine, Reciprocating Pump, Centrifugal Pump, Gear Pump, Reciprocating Air Compressor, Impact of Jet Set Up, Axial Flow Fan & Centrifugal Blower to conduct various Performance Test for practical verification of theoretical principles of fluid machines , to find out various performance parameters of fluid machines & to get performance characteristics of different machines . These equipments are useful to conduct experiments at under graduate level as well as for post level student projects.

name: Advance Programming Lab
description:
No. of Computers: 17

Configuration: INTEL CORE I-5, 4 GB RAM, 500 GB HDD 

The lab is designed to encourage students toward direction of learning of new and modernized technologies. Lab has all the advance programming tools which are required for students to cope up with live practical IT market requirement. This lab is used to carry out practical of the programming subjects like Advance JAVA, Python Programming, Mobile application Development, etc.

name: Computer Lab
description: Computer Lab has 21 Computers connected with high-speed internet. The lab has licensed software like STAAD.Pro, etc.

name: Database System Lab
description:
No. of Computers: 15

Configuration: INTEL CORE I-3, 4 GB RAM, 500 GB HDD

This lab is equipped with modern systems to develop the knowledge about database design and implementation using different Database Management Systems. A database management system (DBMS) is computer application software that provides a way to manage data. The requirement of modern days is to have an automated system that manages, modifies, and updates data accurately. The objective of this lab course is to understand the practical applicability of database management system concepts, working on existing database systems, designing of database, creating relational database, analysis of table design. This lab is used to carry out practical of the subject like Database Management System.

name: Heat Transfer Lab
description: The Heat Transfer laboratory is equipped with setups that study both basic as well as applied heat transfer phenomena targeted for undergraduate heat transfer courses. This laboratory provides fundamental and industrial knowledge about modes of heat transfer, like conduction, convection and radiation, and their application. It gives the in-hand experience of lab-scale experiments on various types of equipments such as heat transfer through forced and natural convection, composite wall, pin fin, lagged pipe, emissivity apparatus, shell and tube heat exchanger, double pipe heat exchanger, dropwise and filmwise condensation, unsteady state heat transfer, etc. The lab aims to provide practical knowledge of experimental methods and it is expected that students will be able to plan an appropriate approach to experiment work, demonstrate safe working in the choice of method and apparatus and collect information to arrive at a final conclusion.

name: Internal Combustion Engine
description:
An Internal Combustion Engine converts chemical energy into mechanical work to run different systems of vehicle. Aim behind this laboratory work is to teach student about basic laws of thermodynamics, heat transfer between various systems and conversion of heat to one form to another form. Students can enhance their knowledge by applying theoretical principle to practical skills. A range of different engines and fuels make students eager to brush their knowledge. After learning, students can understand difference between working of SI and CI engines, evaluate parameters of emissions and understand performance parameters of different engines.
The setup consists of 4-stroke, multi-cylinders petrol (MPFI) engine connected to hydraulic dynamometer for engine loading. The setup has stand-alone type independent panel box consisting of air box, fuel tank, manometer, fuel measuring unit, and digital temperature indicator. The setup enables study of engine for brake power, BMEP, brake thermal efficiency, volumetric efficiency, specific fuel consumption, air-fuel ratio and heat balance. Provision is also made for conducting Morse test.

name: Mechanical Measurements and Metrology  Lab
description:
Metrology is the science of measurement. It is a way through which manufacturers ensure all components parts fit and work correctly. It is essential for solving almost all technical problems in the field of engineering in general, and in production engineering and experimental design in particular. Due to latest advancements in manufacturing techniques, higher productivity and accuracy cannot be achieved unless the science of metrology is properly understood. Therefore, metrology allows engineers to produce products more accurately, more quickly and to a higher standard.
The aim of the Mechanical Measurement and Metrology lab is to educate students about the science of measurements. It provides a means of assessing the suitability of measuring instruments, their calibration, and the quality control of manufactured products. By having relevant knowledge in the area of Measurement and Metrology students will have firm foundation for the pursuit of graduate studies in engineering.

name: MATERIALS SCIENCE AND METALLURGY LAB
description:
Materials are backbone of every industry. Understanding the basics of material science and metallurgy is absolutely vital for every engineers. Mechanical engineers mostly use metals and alloys as the basic inputs materials and are mainly concerned about their mechanical properties. Properties of the metals and alloys are dependent on the internal structure of the metals, chemical composition, shaping history and heat treatment. Therefore, by studying Materials Science and Metallurgy one can co-relate the behavior of the metals and alloys with its structure and properties. 
The aim of the Material Science and Metallurgy lab is to give a practical insight to the students regarding the use of basic principles of science to study the structure-properties relationships of various materials. Students are taught about various Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, heat treatment methods and are given sufficient hands-on practice.

name: Rapid Prototyping Lab
description: Rapid Prototyping is a department facility created in year 2014. The facility is extensively used by students and faculty across the entire institute. The term rapid prototyping (RP) refers to a class of technologies that can automatically construct physical models from Computer-Aided Design (CAD) data. These “three dimensional printers” allow designers to quickly create tangible physical prototypes of their designs, rather than just two-dimensional pictures. Rapid prototyping machine installed at the laboratory works of Fused Deposition modelling Method. The process uses polymer filament (PLA and ABS) as a raw material to build artifacts irrespective of their complexity.

name: Refrigeration and Air-conditioning Lab
description:
The Refrigeration & Air-conditioning Laboratory of this department is equipped with various experiment setups for the Under Graduate Mechanical Engineering Students. Fundamental concepts and experimental exposure about refrigeration and air conditioning systems are provided in laboratory. Ice Plant Trainer: In Ice Plant trainer students get hands on experience on the working of an actual Ice manufacturing plant. This experiment will help students understand how to prepare brine refrigerant and different components of the ice plant systems.Cold Storage Plant: In Cold storage Plant trainer setup enables students to get a hand on experience on the working of an actual cold storage plant. This experiment will help students understand the effect of the various parameters like refrigeration load, refrigerant mass flow rate, condenser cooling rate, etc. on the working cycle.
Cascade Refrigeration Trainer: This Refrigerator Works on working principle of simple Vapour Compression cycle. It continuously circulating, evaporating, and condensing a fixed supply of refrigerant in a closed system accomplishes mechanical refrigeration. Evaporating occurs at a low temperature and low pressure while condensation occurs at a high temperature and pressure. This experiment will help students to understand the compounding systems using different refrigerant in each cycle of the cascade.

name: Software Project Lab
description:
No. of Computers: 15

Configuration: INTEL CORE I-5, 12 GB RAM, 500 GB HDD

This lab provides essential practical experience to consolidate taught theory in industrial applications, helping students develop valuable employability skills and broad engineering industry awareness. Some of the key benefits of R&D lab are Make Students to Complete their academic Project In- House. This lab is used to carry out the practical of the subjects like Software Engineering, Project etc.

name: Web Development Lab
description:
No. of Computers: 20

Configuration: INTEL CORE I-3 , 4 GB RAM ,500 GB HDD
Web Programming Laboratory gives a hands-on, step-by-step guide to develop interactive, Dynamic/static and user friendly Website. Laboratory covers a practical approach of learning HTML and CSS , Languages for building static websites. Integrating text, image, animation, video, and sound content on the web Pages. You will learn practically how we can establish communication between the Web page and Web server using scripting languages. This lab is used to carry out practical of the subjects like Web Technology, Advance web Technology, .net Technology etc.

name: CAD LABORATORY
description:
The CAD laboratory at Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Institute of Technology (formerly known as SVIT, Vasad) is a central facility available with the Department of Mechanical Engineering, wherein all the students of the UG & PG research scholars and faculty can work with 2-D and 3-D design and analysis packages. The users are encouraged to learn, practice and apply the knowledge gained into their research areas. 
Initially this facility is introduced mainly for students to evolve concepts and convert it into a complete product
The CAD lab provides digitally integrated environment where the users can perform: 
Geometric Modeling
,Finite Element Analysis
,Product Development
,Rapid Prototyping.

name: WORKSHOP
description: The workshop is a central facility which is used in first year by students of all branches. It supports teaching activities by providing demonstrations of various hand tools and machine tools used in various manufacturing processes. Students of almost all faculties of engineering uses the facilities in workshop to prepare working models in their project work. The workshop at SVIT is equipped with various shops like Fitting shop, Carpentry shop, Welding shop, Machine shop, Foundry shop, Smithy shop, Sheetmetal shop. The workshop is also equipped with state of the art machine tools like Lathe, Milling, Shaping, Slotting, Cylindrical Grinder, Surface Grinder, Power Press, Submerged Arc Welding, Tungsten Inert Gas Welding, Gas Metal Arc Welding, Shielded Metal Arc Welding, Spot Welding, Pit furnace, Single spindle automat, Electro Discharge Machine.

name: Mobile Computing Lab
description: This Lab is based on wireless networks and mobile systems and their applications in Different fields. The objective of the lab is to develop interactive applications in smartphones with multiple activities including audio, video, and notifications. Lab is equipped with Different mobile app Development platforms and software like Android Studio, Xamarin Studio, SQLite and many more... along with the software used for understanding Wireless applications. Students are using it for making Interactive mobile applications for different platforms, Put them on the platform like Play store, Appstore and make global use of it.

name: Artificial Intelligence Lab
description:
No. of Computers: 18

Configuration: INTEL CORE I-3 , 4 GB RAM ,500 GB HDD

Artificial Intelligence Lab is equipped with sufficient number of computers, software, simulators and other equipment with inter and intra-networking facility required for practical performance. It provides a wide approach in programming and enables to apply knowledge in latest computer algorithms, and Artificial Intelligence. This lab is used to carry out practical of the subject like Artificial Intelligence.

name: High Voltage Lab
description: The High Voltage Laboratory at SVIT was constructed in the year 2003-04. Its major facilities are related to the Generation and Measurements of high voltage AC/DC source and Impulse Generator. Impulse Generator with five stages have a rating of 100 KV/100J. Oil test kit is having a rating of 60 KV. 33 kV, 3 Stage Cascaded Transformer (100 KV) is a part of laboratory added in the lab in the year 2010. It is for Generating 100kV AC. Corona Cage for observation of AC & DC Corona facility was added in the HV lab in the same year 2010, Electrolytic Tank for Electric Field Measurements, Solid Insulation tester (up to 5 KV). Sphere gap Apparatus with Point & Sphere gap with different sizes. Horn gap Arrester is a part of HV lab to demonstrate to the students how Electric Arc is quenched. A 3 point solid plate Earthing is provided to ensure proper safety of Apparatus and Human. It is maintained at very low value and is being measured time to time. Additional safety of human being is ensured with door interlocking facility, during the performance of the impulse and AC/DC ac generation to Electrical insulators etc.

name: Electrical Machine Lab
description:
Electrical Machine Lab is one of the oldest laboratory of the Department established in the year 2018. We have Different Electrical A.C. & D.C. machines like single phase and three phase transformers, single-phase induction motor, various fractional horse-power motors, 3-phase Induction motor, Synchronous Motors and Alternators, D.C. Generator, D.C. Motors with different ratings. . The Universal Power Meter UPM-90 is used in Energy Conservation and Audit subject. Different parts of Electrical Machines viz. samples of different core material with different stamping, Wires for coil winding, Coil winding machine, Armature, Frame of Electric Motor etc. 
This lab is general enough to hold a number of experiments suitable for giving students enough exposure about curriculum. The laboratory is also used for research activities in machines and to carry out project works on different areas like energy conversion, control of electrical machines, monitoring and diagnostics of electrical machines.

name: IoT Laboratory
description:
No. of Kits: 10

Configuration: Raspberry PI 4 With 16 GB SD Card.

This laboratory provides research platform exploring the potential of Internet of Things for multidisciplinary research with more end-user interactions. Demand of the day is to learn and develop smart systems. IOT lab is the place for it. Lab is well equipped with microcontroller kits, Arduino Board, various sensors like Temperature, Light, motion.This lab is used to carry out practical of the subject like Internet of things.

name: Power Electronics & Drives Lab.
description:
Power Electronics Laboratory contains the Various Trainer Kits and Electric Drives. The Trainer Kits include the basic operational characteristics of semiconductor devices like SCR, DIAC, TRIAC, MOSFET, IGBT etc. Various kits of Rectifiers, DC-DC Converters, AC-AC Controllers, and Inverters are used to connect the theoretical aspects students have learnt during theory classes for the better understanding.
Student are making hardware based projects in the laboratory and for that they are using the other facilities like Analog Oscilloscopes, Function Generators, Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO), Power supply with different voltage and current ratings.

name: Communication System Lab 2
description: This lab has Falcon and Scientech make Fiber optics trainer, Laser trainer, Connectorization & Spliceing Kit etc. Fiber Optic Power Meter. This lab also equipped with GSM Evaluation Kit and CDMA Trainer.

name: Power System Lab partially supported by various industries
description:
Power System Laboratory at the Electrical Engineering department of SVIT, Vasad is well equipped with mixed set of facility i.e. Academic laboratory experiment set up and Power System simulation software. At power system laboratory a facility is created recently under the grant received from MHRD under the scheme of MODROB-Rural. A 220 kV volts, 400 km line with a scaled down rating of 400 V, and line length scaled down with equivalent 10 pi sections of L & C with 5A R, L and C and 3 phase, 1 hp motor load and Three phase source with three phase voltage, current and power measurement facility at both sending and receiving end. We can carry out, many experiments: A,B,C,D parameters, Ferranti effect, line performance in terms of efficiency and voltage regulation, different short circuit faults on the line, Shunt Compensation etc. Under the same MODROB-Rural grant received, two more laboratory test set ups are added into the power system laboratory. Three phase synchronous generator 3KVA, Coupled with 3-Phase AC Induction motor as a prime mover with Delta VFDSoft 1.542- VFD software & Power Angle Characteristics of 3 Phase Alternator with infinite bus bars. This will facilitate us to carry out different experiments viz. Sequence Impedances (positive, Negative & Zero Seq. Impedances) of a Synchronous Generator, Fault Analysis (L-G, L-L, LL-G, L-L-L) of a synchronous generator, Power and torque angle measurement for SMIB system. 
To make students aware and get acquainted train them for the use and understanding of different Power System software are a part of facility at the laboratory. MATLAB, PowerWorld Simulator, ETAP Power Station, PSCAD EMTDC are used to carry out simulation based experiments. name: Dynamic balancing machine( MODROB Scheme)
description:
Model: H-100, having capacity of balancing rotor of weight upto 1 tone, was purchased from ABRO Technologies Pvt. Ltd., New Delhi with the fund obtained from MODROB scheme 

A dynamic balancing machine is an advanced device used to measure and correct the imbalances present in rotating machinery components, such as rotors, shafts, and turbines. It employs sophisticated sensors and software to identify the specific areas where the imbalance exists. By rotating the component at high speeds, the machine can detect the areas that deviate from equilibrium, thereby enabling precise adjustments to be made. These adjustments are typically executed by adding weight to or removing weight from the component to counteract the imbalance. Balancing ensures that the rotating machinery operates smoothly, reducing wear and tear on the equipment, minimizing vibrations, and extending its overall lifespan. Dynamic balancing machines play a crucial role in industries such as manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, and power generation, where precise and stable operation of rotating machinery is essential.

name: Aircraft Control and Navigation Lab
description: The Aircraft Control and Navigation Laboratory is designed to provide practical exposure to fundamental concepts used in modern aircraft guidance, control, and monitoring systems. The laboratory integrates navigation sensing and feedback control experiments to help students understand how aircraft maintain stability, follow desired trajectories, and regulate onboard systems. The laboratory is equipped with a Doppler radar system to demonstrate aircraft navigation principles such as velocity measurement, ground speed estimation, and motion detection using Doppler shift. To reinforce aircraft control fundamentals, a PID controller simulator is used to study feedback control behavior. Students perform controller tuning and observe system responses such as rise time, overshoot, steady-state error, and stability under different gain settings. These experiments model aircraft autopilot and attitude control systems, enabling learners to understand how proportional, integral, and derivative actions influence dynamic system performance. The laboratory also includes PID-based control setups for pressure, airflow, and temperature, representing aircraft environmental control and pneumatic subsystems. Using sensors, actuators, control valves, heaters, and fans, students implement closed-loop control to regulate each parameter. These experiments illustrate real-time control challenges, system non linearities, and disturbance rejection, thereby linking theoretical control concepts with practical aircraft system applications.

The interfacing modules like Memory interfacing, PPI, External timer, bus controller, ADC, DAC, matrix display and key board, stepper motor, DC motor, seven segment display, Digital input and output modules. The objective of this laboratory is to train and gain knowledge of hardware and software of different microprocessor and microcontroller and PLC based system to fulfil the demand of present hi-tech era. 

This facility enables the students to show case their talent and interest in the field of microprocessor. Students can implement their thought using assembly and higher-level language like C/C++.

name: ELECTRICAL MEASUREMENT LAB
description: Electrical Measurement and Measuring Instrument laboratory is dealing with the Measurement and instrumentation to the Electrical engineering. The Laboratory contains the Various Trainer Kits and Instruments. This lab has been equipped with various latest digital instruments like Digital Multi-meter, Clamp-on-meter, CRO, various types of bridges, different types of transducers. For the measurement unknown medium resistance we have Wheatstone bridge and measurement unknown low resistance we have Kelvin’s double bridge kit. For the measurement of unknown Capacitor we have Schering Bridge, Wien’s bridge, De-saucy Bridge, Maxwell Bridge kit. For the measurement of unknown inductance we have Owens’s bridge hay’s bridge, Maxwell’s bridge, Anderson bridge kit. For measurement of frequency we have Wien’s bridge kit. We also have different types of electrical transducer kits to convert physical parameter into an electrical signal. We have kit of Linear variable differential transformer (LVDT) for measurement of linear displacement. We have kits of Resistance temperature detector, Thermistor and Thermocouple for measure and control temperature. We have kit of Load cell to measure load in terms of weight, force and pressure. We have kit of Opto-transducer with digital RPM meter to speed measurement. We have kit of I to P converter (Current to Pressure converter). We have kit of angular displacement measurement by using capacitive transducer. We have kit to measure conductivity using conductivity cell. We have kit of Strain gauge to measure strain in Cantilever beam. We have kit of pH value measurement using Combination electrode.

name: Surface Engineering
description:
Inauguration of Surface Engineering and Nanotechnology Lab was done on 17th June 2022, by Shri Ronakbhai Patel (Chairman, NEST), Shri Alpeshbhai Patel (Treasurer, NEST) and Shri Dineshbhai Patel (Campus Director, SVIT). The occasion was graced by Dr. S.D. Toliwal (Principal, SVIT), Dr. P.V. Ramana (HOD, Mech. Engg.) and other staff members of SVIT familiy.
Surface Engineering and Nanotechnology Lab is developed by Dr. Sekar Prakash Saladi, Associate Professor, Mech. Engg. Dept. and Prof. Hetal R Chauhan, Assistant Professor, Mech. Engg. Dept., with the help of research grant for Rs. 49.5 Lakhs received from GUJCOST, DST, Government of Gujarat. 
High Temperature Wear, Erosion and Corrosion studies can be performed as per American Society for Testing Materials (ASTM) in this laboratory.
Major Facilities are:
1. High Temperature Modular Tribometer (POD 4.0, Up to 1000 C) 
2. Advanced micro balance for precision weight measurements (up to 0.01 mg)
3. High Temperature Furnace for Corrosion Testing (up to 1200 C) 
4. Air Jet Erosion Test Rig as per ASTM Standards

name: Basic Electrical Engineering Lab-II
description: Electrical Engineering Lab of BEE is used to carry out experiments of Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering like circuits’ concept, Problem analysis, component identification and their use, Design solutions for engineering circuits and design system components. The course is planned to augment the students’ theoretical understanding of important logical principles by engaging them in the real world applications in the lab. The Electrical Lab also has further purpose of developing the students’ experimental testing and evaluating electrical circuits and systems. It is equally important that students have to develop their practice of using Lab equipment and simulation software like those of Industry. Basic Electrical Engineering Lab is fully equipped to provide excellence in practical knowledge building.
